facts.text: Andrew completed a rock climbing activity and felt a sense of accomplishment.

evidence.quote: Thanks! It was a big achievement for me. The climb was tricky, especially since I'm still a newbie. But I made it with the support and cheer from my friends.
Rock climbing was awesome - I felt so accomplished reaching the top.

facts.text: Andrew expressed interest in trying more outdoor activities, including kayaking and bungee jumping.

evidence.quote: It has definitely encouraged me to try more outdoor activities like kayaking and maybe bungee jumping? Nature always pushes me out of my comfort zone!
